offers.name: Read the catalog
offers.description: Other products look up products, prices, deals and quotes the way shoppers see them.

offers.name: Read a customer's orders
offers.description: Other products read the orders, shipments and account summary of one signed-in customer.

offers.name: Read the store context
offers.description: Other products read the store facts a chat answer can use: hours, delivery, returns and deals.

offers.name: Read permissions
offers.description: Other products list this product's permissions, for the roles of the website's staff.

offers.name: Export a person's data
offers.description: Other products ask this product for everything it keeps about one person.

offers.name: Erase a person's data
offers.description: Other products ask this product to erase or anonymize one person's data.

features.name: Store details
features.description: Who your store is, read from the website's settings in the Portal (set once for every product): its name and tagline, logo, dark logo, icon, favicon and dark favicon, contact email, phones (the main one and more, each with a name) and WhatsApp, address, opening hours with dated exceptions and social links, shown by the shop read GET /v1/shop/store and made into your business.json (GET /v1/shop/store/business-json) for a headless website to serve.

features.name: Catalog
features.description: Products, item types (what each item is and which parts it has), categories with SEO text, brands, the shop's own fields (product, variant, unit, order and customer), media in the merchant's own storage, search, listings and filters, the product page and the catalog admin widget, with best-practice SEO for every page: meta tags, structured data (products, listings, the business and the website) and sitemaps.

features.name: Variants
features.description: Options such as size or color, each variant with its own price, stock and SKU.

features.name: Size charts
features.description: Size charts and measurement tables in any unit you name, with fit advice, shown on product pages from the product, its brand or its category.

features.name: Multi-location stock
features.description: Stock kept per location (warehouses, shops); orders take stock from the first location that has it.

features.name: Condition grades and unit numbers
features.description: Your own condition grades (each with its standard condition, its own return and warranty times, for the item types you choose), and unit numbers for the items whose item type numbers them: picked from units in stock or typed when an order is packed or later, in the formats of the type's unit fields, with your own unit states.

features.name: Digital goods
features.description: Downloads and license keys, given to the shopper once the order is paid.

features.name: Services and bookings
features.description: Services, sold without a time or booked in simple slots as their item type says: a duration, booking schedules per place, person or service with weekly hours and dated exceptions (holidays, special hours), and no double booking.

features.name: Sell in any unit
features.description: Sell in decimal quantities of your own unit, in any language: per meter, per kilogram, per square foot, per hour, per dozen, per tola or per carat. An item type names the unit, its decimals and the step, least and most a shopper buys (such as 2.5); prices are per unit, and stock and quantities count thousandths of it. Tie the unit to a standard measure to send unit prices in feeds and structured data.

features.name: Cart and checkout
features.description: The cart, checkout, the merchant's own payment methods (paid online, paid first such as a bank transfer, on delivery or at pickup, each with its note, fee, largest order and advance), orders with merchant-defined statuses, couriers with tracking links, customer records and the success page.

features.name: Delivery zones
features.description: Delivery zones by any place (countries, regions, cities, areas or postcodes), each with named rates the shopper picks (Standard, Express …; by package weight or order value, free over an amount, with their days), and pickup.

features.name: Courier APIs
features.description: Book shipments with a courier's API using the merchant's own keys and read the latest tracking status.

features.name: Taxes
features.description: Tax rules by region (country, region, city or postcode) and category, each a percentage; prices shown with or without tax.

features.name: Coupons
features.description: Codes for a percentage or fixed amount off, with limits, dates and conditions.

features.name: Deals
features.description: Automatic offers on products, categories or brands, with dates and use limits.

features.name: Loyalty
features.description: Points earned on delivered orders and redeemed at checkout, with expiry and a history.

features.name: Role pricing
features.description: Signed-in shoppers with a listed Accounts role get a percent off the goods after offers, or fixed prices per product or variant, shown as its own line on quotes, orders and invoices.

features.name: Bundles
features.description: Bundles and buy X get Y offers applied in the cart.

features.name: Reviews
features.description: Ratings and reviews from shoppers whose order was delivered, with moderation.

features.name: Wishlist
features.description: Shoppers save products to their wishlist.

features.name: Alerts
features.description: Back-in-stock and price-drop alerts sent through Notifications.

features.name: Compare
features.description: Shoppers compare products side by side.

features.name: Returns
features.description: Return and warranty claims with time windows per item and grade, photos, approval, refunds and restocking exactly once.

features.name: Invoices
features.description: Invoices and packing slips, with the serial numbers on each line.

features.name: CSV
features.description: Import and export products and stock, export orders and customers, as CSV, with a column for each of your fields.

features.name: Bulk actions
features.description: Change prices, stock, status, category, brand, tags, item type, compare-at price or any field of many products at once, and move many orders at once.

features.name: Reports
features.description: Sales by any grouping (product, category, brand, tags, place, zone, courier, payment method, period or any field), a summary by day, week or month, stock age, return rate and margin.

features.name: Events
features.description: Order, return, review, catalog and stock events for your server: listed by the API and sent to your webhooks through Notifications.

features.name: Staff alerts
features.description: Email, text (SMS) or WhatsApp your staff about new orders, status changes, payments, transfer proofs, cancels, expiries and return claims, through Notifications.

features.name: SEO
features.description: Your own SEO on top of the catalog's: title and description patterns, your home page and business details for search engines, sitemap and listing choices, SEO copy written on save, IndexNow on save, and landing and glossary pages (Landing pages).

features.name: Landing pages
features.description: Landing pages by category, brand and any field shoppers filter by, with their own copy, indexed while enough products are in stock, and glossary pages of fields and grades.

features.name: Feeds
features.description: Product feeds for shopping and social catalogs.

features.name: AI copy
features.description: Product descriptions and meta text written with the merchant's own AI key.

features.name: llms.txt
features.description: An llms.txt of the catalog for AI assistants.

features.name: Import
features.description: Catalog, customers, orders, promotions, loyalty and shopper records moved in from another system with ss-import (server token only; no messages, events or alerts). Our admins switch it on for a migration and off after it.
